# ioprodz

> Go AI, stay in charge.

For founders and small businesses who want AI-speed software that holds up in production, ioprodz is a product studio that builds, rescues and runs your app on our own software factory, xdriven. Unlike AI app builders that stop at the demo, or agencies that hand over code and leave, every change ships with tests, a preview, a review and a guarded deploy, and you keep plain Git and Docker you own. Founded late 2025 by Osmane Kalache; serving Europe and North Africa, in English, French and Arabic.

## What we do

- Audit: a review of an AI-built app (security, data, deploy) with a written plan, on quote
- Build or rescue: a programme delivered on xdriven, typically about 90 days, scoped up front, on quote; you see the board, the previews and the release notes
- Run: we stay after launch, xdriven plus a few CTO days a month, on quote
- The right model for every job, privacy and sovereignty first: local open-weight models where data must stay with you, frontier models where they earn their place, no vendor lock-in
- Coaching on TDD, DDD, XP, CI/CD, fast feedback loops, and the practices that make AI features survive production

## The thesis

Autonomous software isn't coming. It's how we ship today. Agents take the ticket, write the code, open the pull request and deploy behind guardrails, every day, on our own factory. People stay in charge: they decide what gets built, review what ships and own the result. The teams that win aren't the ones burning tokens; they're the ones with the engineering to let agents run.

## Who ioprodz is for

- Business owners and non-technical founders with no developer, who don't want to be left behind: the studio builds and runs the software with them
- Technical founders who build with coding agents: [xdriven](https://www.xdriven.dev), our software factory, on its own ("Go full AI. Keep the engineering.")
- Engineers leveling up into architecture or leadership who want to ship AI features without losing engineering craft (coaching)

## What ioprodz is against

- Shipping more AI features just because "AI." Users can't keep up, products destabilize, trust craters.
- Token-grinding: frontier model providers profiting from half-baked features burning requests
- Vendor lock-in disguised as "best-in-class AI"
- The myth that AI-native means engineering-optional

## Services

- [Consulting / IT Strategy](/consulting/it-strategy): Interim CTO, technical roadmap, architecture, AI integration strategy
- [Consulting / Coaching](/consulting/coaching): Team and individual coaching on engineering practices — TDD, DDD, XP, CI/CD, pair programming
- [Manifesto](/about): The full story of why ioprodz exists and what it stands for
- [Blog](/blog): Notes from the engine room on AI engineering, practices, and shipping software that holds up

## Products

Software we build and run ourselves, live in production ([Products](/products)).

- [xdriven](https://www.xdriven.dev) (flagship): Our software factory. Coding agents take each ticket to production with tests, a preview, a review and a guarded deploy. It builds and deploys itself every day, and our own products run on it. Built for technical founders who work with agents; the studio uses it to build, rescue and run apps for those who can't.
- [xDriven chat](https://chat.ioprodz.com): Your mail as chats: everyone you write to is one conversation over your whole history, with newsletters and notifications kept apart. We use it in-house every day; it is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.
- [Muzio](https://muzio.ioprodz.com): A social music app: upload your tracks, share playlists with friends and mix live with a built-in two-deck DJ mode, on the web or Android. It is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.
- [MissionFit](https://missionfit.app): IT freelance missions, driven from your AI: track each mission, tailor your CV with an AI that makes nothing up and follow every application, in the app or from Claude, ChatGPT and Le Chat. Recruiters run their missions and candidates in it too. It is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.
- [Polysee](https://polysee.dev): One workspace for software delivery: connect GitHub or GitLab to see your delivery metrics, write docs together and coordinate your team and its AI agents, without switching tools. It is built and runs on xdriven, our software factory.

## Demos and lab

Open-source tools and experiments from the studio. Not products: what we try out before it goes into the factory ([Lab](/lab)).

- [SpecJest](https://github.com/ioprodz/specjest) (open source): A command-line tool that turns Gherkin .feature files into Jest test skeletons, and back, so specs and tests stay in step.
- [cloviz](https://github.com/ioprodz/cloviz) (open source): A local dashboard for your Claude Code sessions: costs, activity over time, and full session replay. Your data stays on your machine.
- localvoice (lab): Voice chat with a language model that runs entirely on a laptop: nothing leaves the machine. It can also join a video call as a voice assistant.
